title: How Focus with Stan Getz began
summary: A change of A&R men at Verve brought the project, and Creed Taylor.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x:
Focus a little bit.
How did that come about?

It was a shift in A & R people at Verve. Stan was going to Verve, and this guy, I guess had been an agent. Irv Dinkin said he never was an A & R man, his name is Irv Siders; do you know a guy named Irv Siders?

Irv Dinkin insists that he was never an A & R man, but he's the guy who called me and he was an A & R man at Verve, and kicked it off that I should do something with Stan and had me go see Stan. I knew Stan from Germany too, and also from in Benny's band.
So it was agreed that I do something and I started to get ideas together for it and I get a call, they had switched the A & R man at Verve--what's the guy's name?
Creed Taylor. Creed didn't want me there. He said stop the presses, so I stopped.
About three or four weeks later Stan called and said, how's it going? I told him they said to stop, so he must have gotten on with Creed and it was on again and then it went.
